svg.title: Cell with movable parts
svg.desc: Original OpenSketch flat schematic. Independent vector parts; use the Scientific structures palette for path editing.

ellipse.style: stroke: rgb(37,73,75); stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-dashoffset: 0; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-miterlimit: 4; fill: rgb(216,239,233); fill-rule: nonzero; opacity: 1;

stroke: rgb(37,73,75); stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-dashoffset: 0; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-miterlimit: 4; fill: rgb(155,129,181); fill-rule: nonzero; opacity: 1;

circle.style: stroke: rgb(37,73,75); stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-dashoffset: 0; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-miterlimit: 4; fill: rgb(221,209,232); fill-rule: nonzero; opacity: 1;
